electric-cobalt.$description: Electric Cobalt — New In badges, active nav pill, current-slide indicator, claim moments — the only chromatic signal in the system, used sparingly so it reads as activation not decoration

pale-iris.$description: Pale Iris — New Color badge fill, soft highlight wash, tinted surface for variant callouts — a desaturated ghost of the cobalt that whispers color without breaking the monochrome regime

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, default borders, icon strokes, hairline dividers — the dominant structural color across headings, lists, and links

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

plaster.$description: Plaster — Secondary surface for product cards, nav bar background, soft elevation tier above the canvas

slate.$description: Slate — Card border tone, neutral button fill, muted button border — the gray that defines card edges without darkening them

fog.$description: Fog — Light card border, divider lines, inactive surface tint

graphite.$description: Graphite — List and navigation borders, structural dividers between rows and cells

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary text, muted body copy, de-emphasized metadata, link rest state

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Body text alternate, subtle dark surface for inset blocks

roobert.$description: Primary brand typeface — used for everything from 13px body to 128px hero. The -0.04em tracking is consistent across all sizes, pulling the lowercase wordmark into a tight, sculpted mass. Weights escalate by context: 400 for body and UI, 500 for emphasized labels, 600 for product names, 700 for large display.

space-mono.$description: Technical metadata — prices (€189,00), Top 10 rank numerals, ticker marks, shop name credits. Drops in where the page needs to feel like a spec sheet rather than marketing copy.

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
